hero.lede: CodeGlyphX generates and decodes QR codes, Data Matrix, PDF417, Aztec and dozens of barcode formats in pure .NET. Render to PNG, SVG, PDF and more, or turn a QR code into artwork that still scans. No System.Drawing, SkiaSharp or ImageSharp.

surfaces.name: .NET
surfaces.body: One NuGet package for .NET Framework 4.7.2, .NET Standard 2.0, .NET 8 and .NET 10.

surfaces.name: Playground
surfaces.body: Generate, style and decode codes in your browser, running CodeGlyphX in WebAssembly.

surfaces.name: PowerShell
surfaces.body: ImagePlayground brings QR codes, payloads, barcodes and decoding to PowerShell.

surfaces.name: Windows
surfaces.body: WPF controls and example applications for desktop scanning and generation.

surfaces.name: API reference
surfaces.body: Every public type and member, generated from the current release.

art.title: Artwork that still scans
art.body: Theme presets, module palettes, rounded finders, gradients, image composition and procedural patterns. Functional patterns and the quiet zone stay intact, and the examples check every export with the CodeGlyphX decoder.
art.proof: Each design in the colorful gallery must decode back to https://codeglyphx.com from the original pixels, a half-size copy and a lightly blurred copy before the example completes. Test your delivery size and target readers before printing.

gallery.title: Procedural art
gallery.alt: Six procedurally patterned QR codes with swirls, stripes and tiles around intact finder patterns.

gallery.title: Colorful gallery
gallery.alt: Six colorful QR designs with gradients, confetti and illustrations woven into the data area.

decode.title: Read them back
decode.body: Decode QR, Micro QR, barcodes, Data Matrix, PDF417 and Aztec from PNG, JPEG, BMP, GIF and other documented image formats. Byte, pixel, dimension and time budgets keep untrusted input bounded.

powershell.intro: ImagePlayground, the Evotec PowerShell module for visual automation, uses CodeGlyphX for QR codes, typed payloads, barcodes and decoding.

about.title: One module, three libraries
about.body: A single Install-Module gives scripts the same .NET libraries that applications reference directly, so charts, QR codes and photo edits come from one toolset.

libraries.name: ChartForgeX
libraries.role: Charts, topology, dashboards, canvases and animated stories

libraries.name: OfficeIMO
libraries.role: Image processing, metadata and pixel comparison
